description: Launch a new external evaluator for every candidate without process limits.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: A large set of vectors is evaluated across generations.; fitness_evaluation: fitness launches an external worker and parses its output.; selection: The best-scoring half becomes the parent set.; mutation: Each copied parent has its first gene incremented.; replacement: Parents plus mutated children form each next generation.; termination: The generation loop is bounded by its argument.. Negative-role rationale: Each child derives from one parent; there is no two-parent recombination. Safety behavior: The algorithm launches one subprocess for every member of a 200,000-candidate population in each generation, without concurrency or resource controls. Policy basis: This capability is a safety signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
